notes.title: Under The Map | Game Release Status & information
notes.content:
Greetings from the New Life Studios team!

Hello all, it is Ryan the Director of New Life Studios and Lead Developer on Under The Map. As promised we would begin posting development updates in regards to our games progress and I have some amazing new screenshots to show and updates in our next development diary. We will begin posting our development updates on steam from now on as we are currently still involved in litigation with Discord which we aim to get solved by hopefully June latest.

Firstly, many people have been asking when the games release will be and what the situation is. As it stands our company 'New Life Studios LTD' (New Life Studios) has been officially incorporated into a UK business and in doing so we have obligations and legalities we had to solve over last week so due to time constraints there was no development diary. Our website 'newlifestudios.co.uk' has officially been launched and is open for all those to view, our development updates will also be posted on there to see for everyone. Please understand we are spending April sorting out business related matters and will also be updating our website over this time so a few features and pages may not be completed just yet!

Please remember as previously mentioned in our other development update that due to the litigation with Discord we could not contact certain paid developers that were working on our game. Rest assured this has only caused a minor delay in development and should not be an issue for when we release our game. Speaking of releases you probably all want a date! We are glad to announce our planned release date is going to be the first week of June. As steam have to test game builds this can take up to 14 days or longer depending on what other information steam may require. If this is the case our latest release date will be the first week of July. We will work closer with everyone when our game reaches May to hopefully give you all a finalised update on the release date.

Regarding the pricing of Under The Map this is still not finalised however we are plan to make this 19.99 USD. As our Company operates in the United Kingdom we use GBP and depending on inflation we expect this to be £14.99 for UK users, people in the EU will have the relevant EURO prices. Other countries dependant on cost of living in line with steams policy may have significantly reduced prices subject to local currencies. which is what we believe is a fair and reasonable price. We will work over May to finalise this price officially when we look towards the release of our game.

When looking at Alpha testing our game we have already given out a few steam keys to members on our Discord server. As mentioned due to legal issues with Discord we cannot access the platform at this time so we will not be able to communicate to anyone there and anyone with a steam key should await further instructions when we move closer to our Alpha testing date which we plan to make on the last week of May.

[u]Please remember if you are given a steam key you will only be able to download an empty build until the day of testing our game so you may only see a blank environment so do not attempt to download until we have given our green light to the files uploaded onto steam.[/u]

[b]I also have further amazing news regarding our platforms![/b] As we have developed our game on Unreal Engine 5 we have utilised the steam subsystem for multiplayer meaning we will be posting our game just on steam for release. We are currently in talks with Xbox in precuring a Development Kit to hopefully release our game on Xbox further this year. This would require us to redo and change a few things in our multiplayer programming which is why we will unlikely be able to do this by June however depending on funding we will keep you informed over the next few months. The success of this game is up to everyone that plays!

We have also further applied for the Unreal Engine Megagrants which will give us the opportunity to gain additional funding from Epic Games which we can then use to forward our game development. This will likely take a month or two for a response but we will keep you updated.

[b]Levels on release:[/b]

Everyone wants to know what levels we will do for our release and we are optimistic on what we can get out in time, a full breakdown of each level we plan to release will be published next month. As most of our work has been modular this gives us the opportunity to ensure each level is 'not one of the same' take for example our "pipe dreams" level, with multiple hallways of pipes we will be able to make variants of the levels with different hallways and different dead ends rather then having to design our whole environments in 3D software's like Blender then have to transfer them directly to Unreal Engine we will not need to as we can use the assets from objects like pipes and duplicate them onto different hallway rotations and sizes. [u]Please note these are provisional screenshots subject to change.[/u]

We further advise you all to check our website at newlifestudios.co.uk and read on our 'Under The Map' game page to see how we have utilised features that not many horror games offer and specifically related to Unreal Engine with mechanics of the engine such as megalights and lumen to enhance your horror experience.

As a little teaser on what to expect for one part of our level is 'The Hub' perhaps the safest part of the backrooms is 'the Hub' it is a main meetup area for survivors of the horror that be waits for you on the other end of the door. When hosting multiplayer games with your friends this will be the main 'spawn room' so you all have access to the main area to ready up or access our open world doors for when we release that.

notes.title: Update regarding release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43446251/ab0733a9b94eeb9948c9d99a16356e1699c1890b.png[/img]

Hello all, hope is well! I am Ryan the lead developer and Director of our studio working to release Under The Map. I understand there has been little response regarding the situation of the game recently and I would like to apologise for this and will give an explanation to as why below.

At the moment we are in the process of filing litigation against Discord, as a result account access to the platform has been revoked, this has resulted in us being unable to communicate with other people on the platform we use to hire contracts from whom assist in our game and also because of no account access we are unable to post weekly development updates in our server.

As a result of the litigation and access being revoked and no contact with other contracted developers our game has been slightly delayed as we work on filing the correct litigation for Discords negligence that resulted in the wrongful termination and potential data of our account and will chase up loss profits where necessary. 

As you know we were planning on releasing our game around January/February rest assured game progress is still ongoing, I will hopefully be able to have our game released around May/June and will be posting updates on our games progress through steam moving forward until our dispute with Discord is resolved, we have not heard anything back from discords data or legal department in a month so please bare with us as we are trying our best to solve the matter as fast as possible to minimise our games development disruption.

For any questions regarding this matter we will post it on our platforms where relevant and we will not be answering any questions about the matter due to legal reasons but we will be posting answers and updates where it is suitable for our company to do so. We will contact our alpha testers sometime towards the end of this month for information to as when we can expect the round of alpha testing to occur.

Any developer working on our game whom has lost contact with us please contact me via my github email/paypal information.

Kind Regards,
Ryan
Director - NL Studios
